recap.text: Carl's regular loot boxes are dull, and so is the boss box from the one Odious Creeper they killed. That box hands him a bunch of satchel bombs, little bags with leather handles that he tosses and detonates. Each has the power of three sticks of hobgoblin dynamite, enough to level a small town, but the notes call it a good prize and nothing unique.

Carl messages Elle, Katia, Donut, Li Na and Mordecai: spread the word that everyone must stop fighting each other. Crawlers who have lost keys are to clear the stairwell chambers of debris, isolate them, blow up what surrounds them and tunnel underneath with Build Trench scrolls, making room for a whole party. Mordecai is to take the pile of satchel bombs from Carl's bomber's studio and put them on the market for the demolition.

beats.headline: Good, but not unique
beats.text: Carl's regular loot boxes are uninteresting, including the boss box from the one Odious Creeper they killed. It gives him a bunch of satchel bombs: basically little bags with leather handles that he can toss and detonate with the power of three sticks of hobgoblin dynamite, which is enough to level a small town. It is a good prize, but it is not anything unique.
beats.gist: The boss box gives Carl satchel bombs, three hobgoblin dynamite sticks apiece; good, but not unique.

beats.headline: Stock for the market
beats.text: Carl messages Elle, Katia, Donut, Li Na and Mordecai: spread the word, everyone has to stop fighting each other. Whoever has lost keys should clear the stairwell chambers of debris, isolate them fast, blow up what is around them and tunnel underneath with Build Trench scrolls, room enough for a whole party. Mordecai is to go into Carl's bomber's studio, take the pile of satchel bombs and put them on the market to help people with the demolition. Carl has been making them for the next floor, so they are safe for regular crawlers to handle.
beats.gist: Carl tells his allies to stop fighting, then sends Mordecai to sell the satchel bombs.
